decisions.reason: The revised bushing arrangement does not change the specified shaft material, fabrication sequence, or post-weld 82 mm internal machining.

Changing the bushing arrangement does not alter the assembly-aligned drawing-numbering convention.

The bushing guidance and retention decision has no effect on the required 120-degree separation of the lug-hole axes.
